race.comment: PRECAMBRIAN (1) stepped up to a middle distance for the first time, travelled wide, and was still too strong in the run to the line, scoring by half a length at Echuca just over 3 weeks ago. This is not much tougher, and we are expecting that he can now go right on with the job. JUST DANCE (3) took luck out of the equation when leading all the way to score here last time out, and he remains in the same class. He can adopt similar tactics here after drawing the pole position, and an extra 2kg should not be enough to stop him from going close to repeating the dose. NINYO (4) is a durable veteran mare who looks to be very well placed in this. She benefits from a 3kg claim, and will find this easier than any of her recent starts. The only query would be a genuine good track, but if it is wet, keep her very safe. STOLE HIM (5) has raced his way into form with a step up in trip, and he has top 4 claims again.
